<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex13012023-07-2008-36-52" status="reviewed"> <lg><l>gang zhig dngos stobs blo yis dngos rnams la ||</l> <l>log lta'i gzhung rnams rab 'jig dngos nyid dang ||</l> <l><lb n="1b3"/> <rs type="deity">ston pa</rs>'i gsung don nges byed rigs pa'i tshul ||</l> <l><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3773"><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3774">rnam nges</rs> mdzad pa</rs> de 'dir rgyal gyur cig ||</l></lg><note type="translation">May the one who composed the Pramāṇaviniścaya be here victorious!
(The Pramāṇaviniścaya) that destroys the traditions of mistaken views about entities by a mind (that conforms to) the force of reality, which has a method of reasoning that ascertains what is real and the meaning of the words of the teacher.
</note></seg></TEI>
